meta.method: Static reading of crates/ui-egui (ribbon, dialogs, panels, backstage, canvas, status, menus, show) and crates/engine (cmd! registry, keys). Source refs are crates/<file>:<line> resolved at generation time. Entries with source "office" are Microsoft PowerPoint controls absent from deckcraft; they have no upstream implementation to translate.
meta.shortcutNotation: Windows form. The registry writes Cmd+ for the platform command key; on macOS show ⌘ (Ctrl+ → Cmd+), Shift → ⇧, Alt → ⌥ (ribbon.rs pretty_shortcut).
